title: Quaint Silky Chinese Pork Dumplings
description: This traditional Shandong dish features silky dumplings filled with a savory mixture of pork, coriander seeds, and spices, perfect for a delightful dinner experience. The combination of ingredients creates a rich umami flavor that is both adventurous and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.

ingredients.name: ground pork
ingredients.notes: preferably with some fat for flavor

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, toasted coriander seeds, grated ginger, chopped green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper, and mix everything well until just combined.
Lay a dumpling wrapper on a clean surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edge of the wrapper to help seal the dumpling.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In a large pot, bring a quart of water to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer.
Carefully add the dumplings to the pot, making sure not to overcrowd it, and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the pot with a slotted spoon and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped green onions and a drizzle of soy sauce, if desired.
